auth.description: Roles and API key scopes the app's routes may require.

counters.description: Declared counters, by name. Counters are maintained on write and read in O(1).

handlers.description: Asynchronous handlers: triggers, jobs, and schedules.

sourceMap.description:
Manifest paths (`routes[2].plan.body[1]`) to source locations (`app.ts:41:5`), for
diagnostics. Never affects execution.

oneOf.description: Anyone may call the route.
The caller must be signed in.

The caller must be a member of the org named by a path parameter, or present an API key
for that org.

apiKeyScopes.description: Scopes an API key needs to call the route. Empty means API keys aren't accepted.

org.description: The path parameter holding the org id.

roles.description: Member roles allowed to call the route. Empty means any member.

AuthConfig.description:
The roles and API key scopes an app declares. Routes may only require declared ones, so a typo
is a validation error instead of a route nobody can call.

ChannelDecl.description: A realtime channel: clients subscribe by key, plans publish messages to it.

key.description: Fields that identify one stream of the channel, for example `{ roomId }`.

ComputedPart.description: A computed index part: a pure expression over the row, bound to `var`.

name.description: A name for the part, for diagnostics and docs.

var.description: The variable the row is bound to.

Counter.description: A counter over the rows of an entity, grouped by some of its fields.

groupBy.description: Fields the count is grouped by.

sum.description: Sum this integer expression over the rows instead of counting them.

where.description: Only rows matching this predicate are counted.

CronScan.description: The rows a scanning cron walks through.

index.description: Scan this index instead of the primary key.

prefix.description: Constant values for a prefix of the scanned fields.

DefaultValue.description: How a missing field gets its value.

oneOf.description: A constant value.
The current time (timestamp fields only).
A newly generated id (id fields only).

Entity.description: A stored entity: a schema plus an ordered primary key.

invariants.description:
Rules every row must satisfy, by name. Checked on every write; a write that breaks one
fails the request and rolls back.

key.description:
Primary key fields, in order. Rows are stored sorted by this key, so a prefix of the key
selects a contiguous range.

mutable.description: `false` for append-only entities: rows can be inserted but never updated or deleted.

message.description: Human-readable message returned to the client.

EventDecl.description: A declared event with a typed payload.

oneOf.description: A constant.
A variable.
A validated route input.
The signed-in caller's user id, or `null`.
The caller's role in an org (a declared role), or `null` if they aren't a member.
The current time in milliseconds.
A field of a row or object.
`true` if the value is `null`.
Boolean negation.
Integer negation.
A binary operation.
`true` if the value equals one of the constants.
Choose between two values.
Choose a value by matching a string. `_` is the default case.
An object built from named values.
A list built from values.
The first item of a list, or `null` if it's empty.
The length of a list or string.
A string transformation.
A string test, such as `startsWith`.
The first `max` characters of a string.
Absolute value of an integer.
String concatenation. Non-string parts are formatted.

Field.description: A field declaration: a type, optionality, and an optional default.

default.description: Value used when the field isn't provided.

optional.description: Whether the field may be absent (stored as `null`).

FieldType.description: Field types. Every type has a statically known maximum size.

oneOf.description: A UTF-8 string with a length range in characters. `max` is required.
A 64-bit signed integer with an optional range.
A boolean.
One of a fixed set of string values.
A generated, time-ordered identifier (26-character ULID).
Milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
A list with a maximum length.

Handler.description: A handler: a plan run asynchronously when something happens.

errors.description: Declared errors. Failing with one counts as a failed attempt, which is retried.

plan.description: The handler's logic. Its output is ignored.

Idempotency.description:
Idempotency settings for a route. A successful response is stored with the request's key in
the same transaction as the route's writes, and replayed for the same key within `ttl_ms`.

required.description: Whether requests without an idempotency key are rejected.

ttlMs.description: How long a stored response is replayed, in milliseconds (at most 7 days).

fields.description:
Indexed parts, in order: field names or computed values. Queries match a prefix of these,
optionally with a range on the next one.

unique.description: At most one row per indexed value. Rows with a `null` part aren't constrained.

where.description: Only rows matching this predicate are indexed (a partial index).

IndexPart.description: One part of an index: a field, or a value computed from the row.

anyOf.description: A computed value, such as a lowercased email.

Input.description: Route inputs. Every input is validated before the plan runs.

params.description: Path parameters. Must match the `:name` segments of the path exactly.

InputSource.description: Where an input value comes from.

oneOf.description: A handler's payload.

Integration.description: A declared integration: the only way plans reach the outside world.

config.description: Provider configuration (base URL, secret names, ...), interpreted by the platform.

provider.description: Which provider implements it, for example `"http"`, `"email"`, `"stripe"`.

output.description: Output fields (calls only). The response is validated against them.

Literal.description: A constant value in a manifest.

McpTool.description: An MCP tool backed by a route.

name.description: Tool name, unique within the app.

Op.description: An operation. Operations are the only way a plan touches storage.

oneOf.description: Read one row by its full primary key. Evaluates to the row or `null`.

key.description: A value for every primary key field.

oneOf.description: Insert a new row. Fails if a row with the same key exists. Evaluates to the row.

values.description: Field values. Missing fields take their default, or `null` if optional.

oneOf.description: Insert a row, or update it if one with the same key exists. Evaluates to the row.

values.description:
Field values. On insert, missing fields take their default. On update, missing fields
keep their value.

oneOf.description: Insert a row unless one with the same key exists. Evaluates to whether it inserted.
Update fields of an existing row. Evaluates to the updated row.

key.description: A value for every primary key field.

set.description: New field values. Key fields can't be changed.

oneOf.description: Delete a row if it exists. Evaluates to `null`.

key.description: A value for every primary key field.

oneOf.description: Read a bounded, ordered range of rows. Evaluates to a list of rows.

after.description: Continue after this cursor (a string from a previous page, or `null` for the start).

index.description: Scan this secondary index instead of the primary key.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows. Must have a statically known upper bound.

page.description:
Evaluate to `{ items, cursor }` instead of a plain list. `cursor` is `null` when the
page wasn't full.

prefix.description: Values for a prefix of the key (or index) fields.

range.description: Bounds on the scanned field right after the prefix.

oneOf.description: Read a counter value. Evaluates to an integer (0 if never incremented).

key.description: Values for the counter's `groupBy` fields, in order.

oneOf.description: Transform each item of a bounded list. The body may read but never write.

item.description: The variable each item is bound to.

oneOf.description:
Keep the items of a bounded list for which `keep` is true. The body may read but never
write.

item.description: The variable each item is bound to.

oneOf.description: Emit an event. Released after commit.
Put a job on a queue, optionally delayed (at most 30 days). Released after commit.
Publish a message to a realtime channel. Released after commit.

key.description: Values for the channel's key fields.

oneOf.description: Run an integration call and evaluate to its (validated) output. Journaled.
Send an integration effect. Released after commit.
Evaluate a pure expression.
Runs during the plan and returns data. Journaled: a retried attempt reuses the result.
Fire-and-forget, delivered through the outbox after commit.
Ascending key order.
Descending key order.

Plan.description:
A route's logic: statements followed by the value returned to the caller.

A plan runs as **one optimistic transaction**. A statement that fails rolls it back.

QueryRange.description:
Bounds on the field after a query's prefix. At most one lower and one upper bound. Like SQL
comparisons, a range never matches rows where that field is `null`.

QueueDecl.description: A declared queue: jobs with a typed payload, retried with exponential backoff.

backoffMs.description: Delay before the first retry, in milliseconds. Doubles on each retry.

maxBackoffMs.description: The longest delay between retries, in milliseconds.

retries.description: How many times a failed job is retried (at most 10).

RateLimit.description: At most `max` calls per subject in each `window_ms` window.

windowMs.description: Window length in milliseconds (1 second to 1 day).

RateSubject.description: Who a rate limit counts calls for.

oneOf.description: Each signed-in user (anonymous callers count by IP).
Each client IP.
Each API key's org.
Everyone together.

description.description: What the route does, for generated API docs and MCP tools.

errors.description: Declared business errors the plan may fail with, by name.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the manifest.

idempotency.description: Replays successful responses for repeated idempotency keys.

mcp.description: Exposes the route as an MCP tool with the same inputs, auth, and limits.

rateLimit.description: Limits how often the route may be called.

RowPredicate.description:
An expression over one row, bound to `var`: a boolean predicate (`where`, invariants) or an
integer (counter `sum`).

var.description: The variable the row is bound to inside `expr`.

oneOf.description: Run an operation and bind its result to a new variable.

var.description: The variable to bind. Must not already be defined.

oneOf.description: Fail with a declared error unless `cond` is true.

error.description: The declared error to fail with.

oneOf.description: Fail with a declared error.
Conditional execution. Variables defined inside a branch aren't visible after it.
Run `body` once per item of a list with a statically bounded length.

item.description: The variable each item is bound to.

Trigger.description:
What runs a handler. The handler reads its payload with `input` expressions of source
`payload`:
- `event`, `queue`: the declared payload fields
- `deadLetter`: the job's payload fields, plus `error` and `attempts`
- `entity`: `before` and `after` (rows, `null` when absent)
- `cron`: `firedAt`, plus `batch` (a list of rows) when it scans

oneOf.description: An emitted event.
A committed change to a row.
A job on a queue. At most one handler per queue.
A job that failed every retry.
A schedule: runs at every multiple of `every_ms` (plus `offset_ms`) since the epoch.

everyMs.description: Interval, in milliseconds (1 second to 30 days).

offsetMs.description: Offset into each interval, in milliseconds.

scan.description:
Run once per batch of an entity's rows instead of once per tick. The platform
paginates: each batch is a separate, separately-bounded execution.
